pkgmetadata.longdescription: Oh My Pi (omp) is an AI coding agent CLI with a terminal UI, session management and built-in read, bash, edit and write tools. The native N-API addon (pi-natives) is compiled here from the bundled crates/ workspace rather than shipped prebuilt; app-misc/oh-my-pi-bin installs the prebuilt release binary instead and the two packages block each other.
